_description: Per-product price-sourcing log for the Tier A/B/C live price system. An entry here means a human/agent had to actually research THIS specific product (Tier C search+verify, or a Tier B/A product with a product-specific story like a wrong sourceUrl). Plain Tier A (Shopify) and plain Tier B (known-domain) products do NOT get an entry -- their method is uniform and already documented in SKILL.md, not product-specific. Before re-researching any product from scratch, check here first. Owner standing rule (2026-10-20): EVERY product the owner hands over gets an entry recording where its info/price came from -- a PDF, a live site, or stated directly -- via sourceType. A PDF-sourced product stays marked sourceType=pdf until the owner explicitly asks for an online check; that check is its own logged event (how and where), never a silent edit.

_schema.name: product name as stored in products.json
_schema.tier: A / B / C, or a transition like "C->B" or "A (reclassified from C)"
_schema.sourceUrl: the sourceUrl this record applies to, or null if none/cleared
_schema.method: exactly how this product was found/matched -- search strategy, which candidate, why it was picked
_schema.verification: how the match was confirmed -- image-confirmed, byte-identical-image, dual-source-mrp-confirmed, name-match-only, etc
_schema.confidence: free text, e.g. "high", "medium", "match: high, price: low"
_schema.caveats: anything a future session should know before trusting this record at face value
_schema.batch: which pilot batch / investigation this came from, for cross-referencing codex-briefing.md
_schema.lastUpdated: date of the most recent research on this product
_schema.sourceType: pdf | online | owner-provided -- REQUIRED for every entry going forward. pdf = info/price came from a PDF the owner provided (see pdfName). online = found/verified via a live web source (see sourceUrl, method). owner-provided = owner stated the info/price directly, no document or web source.
_schema.pdfName: Which PDF this came from, when sourceType=pdf (e.g. the catalog filename). null otherwise.
_schema.priceAtEntry: The price as recorded at this entry's last update (from the PDF, the online check, or as stated) -- this is the log's own record, separate from (and to be cross-checked against) products.json's own price field.

_usage: When asked to update or re-verify a product's price: look it up by id here FIRST. If an entry exists, repeat its method/sourceUrl rather than re-searching from scratch, and update lastUpdated + add a note if anything changed. If no entry exists, it's either a plain Tier A/B product (follow SKILL.md's generic method) or genuinely new Tier C work (do the research, then ADD an entry here so the next session does not have to repeat it). Owner rule: use `python3 scripts/product_price_log.py add PRODUCT_ID --source-type pdf --pdf-name "..."` for any product the owner hands over from a PDF (or --source-type owner-provided / online for other ways a product is given). When later asked to check a product online, use `recheck-online PRODUCT_ID --source-url ... --method ...` -- this logs exactly how and where the check was done and flips sourceType to online, keeping the PDF provenance visible in history. Never silently overwrite a PDF-sourced entry's price without going through recheck-online.
